name: NC State Board of Education

plan.title: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

mission.text: To use its constitutional authority to guard and maintain the right of a sound, basic education for every child in North Carolina Public Schools.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Reduce exclusionary discipline and improve school climate, including more school-based mental health professionals.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Increase 4-year-old enrollment in NC Pre-K from 22% to 34%.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Decrease dropout rates and increase postsecondary enrollment, employment or enlistment.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Increase the number of educators of color in North Carolina schools.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Raise math, reading and science proficiency and ESSA interim progress across subgroups, including 3rd-grade reading.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Improve low-performing schools, charter school performance and principal effectiveness.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Support educators throughout their careers and strengthen educator preparation partnerships with districts.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

objectives.text: Increase school connections with the community.

citation.document: NC State Board of Education Strategic Plan

wording_note: Goals and objectives are close summaries of the plan posted on the OSBM Agency Strategic Plans page (retrieved 2026-11-07); check the cited section before quoting. Keywords, search terms and usual funders were chosen by the team as matching aids.
